component.name: MILVUS (SYSTEM, READ-ONLY)
component.description:
What it does Stores embedding vectors in your organization's Milvus vector database and finds the closest ones again - the retrieval half of retrieval-augmented generation, semantic search and recommendations.

How it works Each node runs one operation, chosen in the Inspector. INSERT and SEARCH read the vectors from the incoming data at the path Embeddings Field names - one vector or a list of them, usually straight from an embedding node - and INSERT stores each vector's text and metadata with it. SEARCH returns the closest matches with their distance, text and metadata. The collection name and filter can be filled from the incoming data with ${field} placeholders. A Milvus error fails the run, so vectors are never counted as stored when they are not. Anything else arriving passes through to the next node.

Configure
- Operation - CREATE_COLLECTION, INSERT, SEARCH, DELETE, LIST_COLLECTIONS or DROP_COLLECTION.
- Collection Name - the collection to act on.
- Embeddings Field and Texts Field - where the vectors and their texts are in the incoming data.
- Vector Dimension and Distance Metric - set once, when the collection is created.
- Top K Results - the most matches SEARCH returns per vector.
- Filter Expression - narrows SEARCH, or picks what DELETE removes, such as metadata["source"] == "faq".

In and out In: embeddings, plus texts and metadata for INSERT; ids or a filter for DELETE. Out: the incoming data without the raw vectors, plus the operation, the collection and its result - insert_count and inserted_ids, sources, deleted or collections.

Use it when
- You want an assistant to answer from your own documents.
- You need "find similar" over products, tickets or images.
- An orchestration should build or refresh a vector index as part of a pipeline.
component.short_description: Stores embedding vectors in your organization's Milvus and searches them by similarity.

component.manifest_yaml:
extension_type: agent
name: Milvus
description: >
  Runs one operation against the organization's Milvus vector database -
  create a collection, insert vectors with their texts, search by similarity,
  delete, list collections or drop a collection. Vectors and texts are read
  from request_data at the configured ${path}. A misconfigured node or a Milvus
  failure raises and fails the run.

input_ports:
  - port_name: input
    port_type: in
    # The script never reads input.artifact; it always builds its own JSON
    # result. optional(json) - "a json, or nothing" - keeps it chainable after
    # any artifact-producing node.
    artifact_type_input: optional(json)
    # The vectors and texts are read from the paths Embeddings Field and Texts
    # Field name; embeddings and texts are their defaults.
    request_data:
      embeddings: array (optional) - One vector, or a list of vectors. Required by INSERT and SEARCH at the default Embeddings Field.
      texts: array (optional) - One text per vector, stored alongside it by INSERT, at the default Texts Field.
      metadata: array (optional) - One object per vector, stored alongside it by INSERT.
      ids: array (optional) - The ids of the vectors to delete, for DELETE.
      filter: string (optional) - A Milvus filter expression selecting the vectors to delete, for DELETE. Wins over Filter Expression.
    artifact_type_output: json
    # response_data is the incoming request_data, less the raw vectors, with
    # the operation's result on top.
    response_data_passthrough: request_data
    response_data_passthrough_except: [embeddings, vectors, query_vectors]
    response_data:
      operation: string - The operation that ran.
      collection_name: string - The collection acted on; empty for LIST_COLLECTIONS.
      insert_count: integer (optional) - INSERT only - number of vectors stored.
      inserted_ids: array (optional) - INSERT only - the ids Milvus gave the stored vectors, in order.
      sources: array (optional) - SEARCH only - matches with id, distance, text and metadata; for a list of query vectors, one list of matches per vector.
      collection_missing: boolean (optional) - SEARCH only - true when the collection does not exist, so no matches.
      deleted: integer (optional) - DELETE only - number of vectors removed.
      collections: array (optional) - LIST_COLLECTIONS only - collection names, sorted.

input_parameters:
  - name: operation
    type: select
    label: Operation
    options: [CREATE_COLLECTION, INSERT, SEARCH, DELETE, LIST_COLLECTIONS, DROP_COLLECTION]
    default: SEARCH
    required: true
    description: The Milvus operation this node runs.
  - name: collection_name
    type: text
    label: Collection Name
    default: ""
    description: The collection to act on. Accepts ${field} placeholders.
    depends_on:
      parameter: operation
      visible_when: [CREATE_COLLECTION, INSERT, SEARCH, DELETE, DROP_COLLECTION]
  - name: embeddings_field
    type: text
    label: Embeddings Field
    default: "${embeddings}"
    description: A ${path} reference to the vector, or list of vectors, in the incoming data.
    depends_on:
      parameter: operation
      visible_when: [INSERT, SEARCH]
  - name: texts_field
    type: text
    label: Texts Field
    default: "${texts}"
    description: A ${path} reference to the texts stored with the vectors, one per vector. Optional in the data.
    depends_on:
      parameter: operation
      visible_when: [INSERT]
  - name: dimension
    type: integer
    label: Vector Dimension
    default: 1536
    constraints:
      min: 1
      max: 32768
    description: The length of every vector the collection will hold; it must match your embedding model.
    depends_on:
      parameter: operation
      visible_when: [CREATE_COLLECTION]
  - name: metric_type
    type: select
    label: Distance Metric
    options: [COSINE, L2, IP]
    default: COSINE
    description: How similarity is measured. Set once when the collection is created; searches use it.
    depends_on:
      parameter: operation
      visible_when: [CREATE_COLLECTION]
  - name: top_k
    type: integer
    label: Top K Results
    default: 10
    constraints:
      min: 1
      max: 1000
    description: The most matches SEARCH returns per query vector.
    depends_on:
      parameter: operation
      visible_when: [SEARCH]
  - name: filter_expr
    type: text
    label: Filter Expression
    default: ""
    description: A Milvus filter expression that narrows SEARCH, or selects what DELETE removes. Accepts ${field} placeholders.
    depends_on:
      parameter: operation
      visible_when: [SEARCH, DELETE]

embeddings.description: One vector, or a list of vectors. Required by INSERT and SEARCH at the default Embeddings Field.

texts.description: One text per vector, stored alongside it by INSERT, at the default Texts Field.

metadata.description: One object per vector, stored alongside it by INSERT.

ids.description: The ids of the vectors to delete, for DELETE.

filter.description: A Milvus filter expression selecting the vectors to delete, for DELETE. Wins over Filter Expression.

collection_name.description: The collection acted on; empty for LIST_COLLECTIONS.

insert_count.description: INSERT only - number of vectors stored.

inserted_ids.description: INSERT only - the ids Milvus gave the stored vectors, in order.

sources.description: SEARCH only - matches with id, distance, text and metadata; for a list of query vectors, one list of matches per vector.

collection_missing.description: SEARCH only - true when the collection does not exist, so no matches.

deleted.description: DELETE only - number of vectors removed.
